name: multi-turn-coherence
turns: I'm organising a reading group at the Fairview library. There will be 8 people in it, and we meet on Thursday evenings.
How many copies of the book should I order for them, and when do I need them by?
Actually, make that 12, not 8 - two more couples just joined.
Copies are $14.50 each, and the shop takes 10% off any order of more than 10 copies. What will I pay in total?
Summarise the whole exchange for me - what have we settled on?
